title: The formula bump after a release: after: or a documented step
objective: The formula follows every release by a documented step and a script, never an after: hook (hv, 2026-09-21, vc decision 10; design, Work packages). tools/formula-bump <tag> writes the tag and that tag's commit into packaging/homebrew/utilz.rb from git: it refuses a tag that does not exist or is not annotated, reads the commit with git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}, rewrites only the tag: and revision: lines, refuses a formula without exactly one of each, and prints the diff. No commit is typed by hand, because the offline audit accepts any 40 hex digits. docs/releasing.md documents the step hv runs after each cut: formula-bump, copy into the tap, brew audit --strict, commit and push the tap. At the 2.11.0 cut hv creates and pushes the tap, and the install from it is AC-05.2.
